audit.whatIsWrong: win[0] and phases[0].side both say Zaahen while whys[0] says 'Level 1 is an even skill lane' — the row contradicts its own explanation. The page is also labelled FAV at difficulty 4/10 against a 48.81% win rate over 631 games.
audit.why: Under 50% is not a favoured lane. Level 1 against a tank with Frost Armor (bonus Armor and Magic Resist plus slow immunity out of combat) is genuinely even.
audit.corrected: Row 0 to Skill in both layers with a 5/10 rating, leaving Zaahen 4 / Skill 3; difficulty to EVEN 5.5/10 so the rating line matches the data.

audit.whatIsWrong: No real cooldowns anywhere, and the whole page is built around tracking 'Permafrost's cooldown'.
audit.why: Permafrost is a 1.5s ability — it has no meaningful cooldown at all. It is gated on the target carrying maximum Frost stacks, which come from Winter's Wrath (W, 9s at rank 1). The genuinely punishable cooldown is Arctic Assault (Q) at 18s at rank 1 — her only gap-closer. Zaahen's own spikes are Q 10s, W 14s, E 10s, R 110s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: Retarget the focus and the cooldown breakdown onto Arctic Assault at 18s, and describe Permafrost as stack-gated rather than cooldown-gated.

audit.whatIsWrong: Zaahen's E is written as 'Golden Onslaught' — the missing-interaction data and the mirror audit both name it Aureate Rush, with The Darkin Glaive (Q), Dreaded Return (W) and Grim Deliverance (R). The page also conflates Frost Armor (her passive) with Frost stacks (her W debuff), and never states the stun-shatter.
audit.why: Riot's text: Permafrost 'freezes and stuns an enemy champion that has maximum Frost stacks', and the passive lets her 'damage a stunned enemy to shatter it, dealing massive magic damage'. Breaking off after two Winter's Wrath hits denies the stun and the shatter together — that is the decisive interaction.
audit.corrected: Name the abilities correctly and state the stack gate: two Winter's Wrath hits arm Permafrost, so disengage on the second one; Arctic Assault at 18s is the window to commit into.
